name: pyocd-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is pyOCD, a Python debugger and flash programmer for Arm Cortex-M microcontrollers. Its
session options can be set from keyword arguments and command-line arguments, from a YAML config file and from
defaults; the `pyocd` tool parses its command line and option values, and the commander runs debug commands typed
at a prompt or read from a file.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The code under repair is the session options and configuration layer, the command-line layer and the commander
command processor: the packages pyocd/core/, pyocd/utility/, pyocd/commands/ and pyocd/subcommands/ and the module
pyocd/__main__.py.
The documentation in scope is: the pages docs/configuration.md, docs/options.md, docs/api/using_session_options.md,
docs/command_reference.md and docs/env_vars.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the modules in
pyocd/core/, pyocd/utility/, pyocd/commands/ and pyocd/subcommands/ and of pyocd/__main__.py.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and those
docstrings; in-package code comments are only supporting evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the
documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.12 with pytest
